events.details: Families are invited to join National Park Service Rangers and our friends from the Jamaica Bay Rockaway Parks Conservancy for an afternoon of fishing! Whether you are an aspiring Jr. Angler or have dropped a line before, this hands-on program is the perfect way to experience the fun of fishing together. Discover local marine life, learn how to become an ethical angler, and practice dropping a cast. All fishing gear provided.
